caption: The video showcases a white tabletop with a triangular frame of segmented silver magnetic bars and a large steel sphere at its apex. An inner bar runs downward toward the base while two hands grip the slanted bars around the middle. The hands shift to the lower corners and make small pinching adjustments, keeping the structure nearly in place. After a framing change, a grey-sleeved arm enters from the lower left, and the triangle rests on the right. The left hand reaches to the far left edge and draws a cluster of shiny steel spheres into view. Both hands hold the cluster at the left, turning and pressing it so its outline changes. The spheres remain tightly gathered while the magnetic-bar triangle stays fixed and untouched on the right. The view continues with the cluster being reshaped beside the stationary structure, without showing contact between them.
